thread:
oliver: Flagging a weird onboarding failure: Ruby sampleapp CI PATCH /routes/rollout works with curl but fails via ruby-sdk 1.2.0. Seen on fresh quickstart run.

tamsin: can you paste the exact SDK call and curl?

oliver: sure. SDK (ruby):
```rb
client.routes.update_rollout('r_42', {
  rollout_strategy: 'linear',
  min_available_replicas: 2,
  preserve_sessions: true,
})
```
errors: 400 "unknown parameter: min_available_replicas"

curl:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/r_42/rollout \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"rollout_strategy":"linear","min_available_replicas":2,"preserve_sessions":true}'
```
returns 200.

yu: interesting. server accepts the field but SDK call shows it as unknown. maybe the ruby marshaller converts symbols to strings differently or trims keys not in the typed model.

tamsin: we did add strict param typing to reduce API drift but this keeps biting new flags. also saw that when token refresh triggers mid-request the SDK retries the PATCH without an idempotency header and the rollout runs twice in Dedicated tests. curl doesn't retry so it never duplicates.

harper: two things: SDK strips untyped keys, and non-idempotent retry is unsafe. high onboarding impact.

oliver: repro logs: SDK outgoing body in the request logged shows only {"rollout_strategy":"linear","preserve_sessions":true} — min_available_replicas got dropped. server then complains because quota rules expect min_available_replicas for linear strategy.

yu: short term mitigation: restore passthrough of unknown keys into the body (maybe as "_extras" or preserve them at top-level), and generate an Idempotency-Key for mutating endpoints when retrying. Longer term: update Ruby types and add feature toggles.

tamsin: for rollback safety, can we make SDK only retry idempotent methods unless an idempotency key is present? That would prevent dupes without server changes.

harper: yes, plus add automatic idempotency-key header generation for create/update calls in the SDK unless user supplies their own. Also add a CI test in sampleapp that sends an experimental param like "min_available_replicas" and asserts server observed it.

sdk-ci-bot: Created ticket RDW-1345: "ruby-sdk drops experimental rollout params + unsafe retry behavior" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1345 :white_check_mark:

oliver: I'll open a quick patch to the marshaller to preserve unknown keys and add a warning log so we can track how often it happens.

yu: I'll add the idempotency header generator and tighten retry semantics. We'll also add an integration test in the sampleapp CI that deliberately triggers a 401 mid-request to assert duplicate ops don't occur.

tamsin: please also add a small note in the quickstart README explaining the temporary quirk and that users can set their own Idempotency-Key header. We'll coordinate a minor patch release 1.2.1.

harper: thanks all. appreciate the quick triage — this was blocking a partner demo earlier. :thumbsup:
